lee_support: FYI VeloxPay (ticket #7021) reporting two problems with streaming completions + fncall integration on Dedicated: 1) intermittent truncated JSON in fncall payloads (parser errors), 2) duplicated function_call events for the same operation id. They started after last runtime tweak to eager flush.

rachel_sales: VeloxPay is on dedicated-eu and this blocks a merchant rollout. They want a short-term toggle they can enable while we investigate.

mika_product: Please paste a sample of the raw stream and the webhook error. Need to confirm framing vs payload corruption vs duplicate IDs.

lee_support: Snippet from VeloxPay capture: ```
frame1: {"type":"delta","text":"..."}
frame2: {"type":"tool_event","name":"create_charge","payload":"{\"id\":\"evt_123\",\"amount\":100}"}
frame3: {"type":"tool_event","name":"create_charge","payload":"{\"id\":\"evt_123\",\"amount\":100}"}
frame4: {"type":"tool_event","name":"create_charge","payload":"{\"id\":\"evt_123\",\"amount\":100"}
// notice frame4 missing closing brace -> webhook throws JSON.parse error; frames 2 & 3 duplicate event id -> webhook rejects with 409
```

joey_eng: Looks like two symptoms: emitter sometimes flushes a large payload mid-object (truncation) and occasionally re-emits the same internal event id (dup). Both likely tied to recent flush-on-kvcache-change optimization.

mika_product: Proposed triage options:
- Hotfix 1: server-side atomic frames opt-in header (client requests atomic JSON frames) -> buffer until object boundary before emitting. Fast to implement as a shim.
- Hotfix 2: lightweight dedupe window for tool_event ids (LRU cache) behind runtime flag.
- Root fix: fix emitter flush ordering and add stronger stream regression tests (longer).

adam_pm: We need a quick decision. If we ship an opt-in header, define launch criteria and timeline.

joey_eng: Estimates:
- Hotfix 1 (atomic frames header): ~1.5 dev-days + 0.5 QA + 0.5 canary ops.
- Hotfix 2 (dedupe LRU): ~1 dev-day + 0.5 QA + 0.5 ops.
- Root fix: 4-7 dev-days + extended QA.

mika_product: Acceptance criteria for hotfix header (opt-in atomic frames):
- Unit tests for interleaved delta/fncall sequences that previously produced partial JSONs
- Integration test with streaming SDK demonstrating atomic frames behavior
- Customer (VeloxPay) validation on staging endpoint (they must run their webhook capture)
- Canary at 10% for 6 hours, monitor errors and parsing failures
- Runtime flag to disable if unexpected regressions

ci-bot: deploy-window-check: eu maintenance slot tonight 23:30 UTC -> available

rachel_sales: VeloxPay engineer available 22:00 UTC to validate staging. They asked for a toggle name and short doc blurb so they can enable quickly.

mika_product: Decision: ship Hotfix 1 (atomic frames header) now as opt-in. We'll follow with Hotfix 2 (dedupe) if duplicates persist, and schedule root-fix in next sprint. @joey_eng please assign.

joey_eng: Assigned to noah_eng. Created issue: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/10021 title: "hotfix(streaming): opt-in atomic-frame emission header". Noah starts tonight. Plan: add header X-RW-Atomic-Frames: true -> server buffers until balanced JSON object boundary before emitting a frame.

noah_eng: Implementing now. Will add metrics stream.atomic.buffered_frames, stream.atomic.errors. Unit + e2e tests incoming. Will post staging URL when ready.

adam_pm: I'll own rollout checklist and customer comms. Draft acceptance and faq for the header. Once VeloxPay validates staging we do 10% canary for 6h then promote. Rollback by turning the header off.

lee_support: I'll update ticket #7021 and coordinate the staging test with VeloxPay.

rachel_sales: Please also draft short customer note: why it happened, how to enable toggle, timeline for permanent fix. I'll send it after review. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: deploy-plan-created: https://deploys.internal/plan/68300

joey_eng: Follow-up: added issue to current sprint under lane "streaming-hotfixes".

noah_eng: Starting implementation. Will ping with PR + staging endpoint.

lee_support: Standing by for staging link; will paste VeloxPay's validation here when done.
